android.desc:
QuickNews gives you the 5 most important world news stories right now, ranked by real-world impact — not clicks, not trends, not engagement.

No account. No sign-in. No ads. No tracking of any kind. Just the news.

Our editorial team selects and ranks each story by severity, scale, and global reach. When a bigger story breaks, it replaces a lower-ranked one. Existing stories are reviewed every few hours for significant developments. Each story links directly to its original source — Reuters, BBC News, AP, Bloomberg, The Guardian, and more.

⚙️HOW IT WORKS
QuickNews monitors breaking world news around the clock. Stories are ranked by real-world impact: how severe the event is, how many people it affects, and how far its consequences reach. Not what's going viral. Not what generates clicks. When a more important story breaks, it replaces a lower-ranked one. Each story is updated when significant new developments emerge — no manual refresh needed.

📦WHAT YOU GET
🔹 The 5 most important world news stories, ranked by real-world impact
🔹 A plain-language summary: what happened, why it matters, what comes next
🔹 Direct links to original reporting from trusted international outlets
🔹 Live updates when a story develops — no need to refresh manually
🔹 Works offline — the last known stories are always available
🔹 Adjustable text size and full dark mode support
🔹 Clean, distraction-free reading — no comments, no related articles, no infinite scroll
🔹 Optional push notification when the top story changes

🌍 WHAT'S COVERED
QuickNews covers the global news categories that shape the world:
⚖️ International politics and diplomacy
📈 Global economy and financial markets
🌱 Climate and environment
🩺 Health and medicine
🔬 Science and technology
🪖 War and conflict
🤝 Society and human rights

💡 WHY QUICKNEWS IS DIFFERENT
Most news apps are designed to keep you reading as long as possible. QuickNews is designed to let you stop. Five stories, read in minutes, and you're done. No push notifications demanding your attention, no comment sections, no related articles pulling you deeper, and no ads. No algorithm deciding what you should care about. No feed to scroll. Just five stories, ranked by the people and events actually shaping the world.
